doctrine: A finished story should use multiple media channels WITH CRAFT — every asset earning an explicit purpose (INFORM: data/information the prose cannot carry; IMMERSE: mood/atmosphere that aids reading), not leaning on charts alone and not adding media to tick a channel. Aim for breadth across chart, image, video, audio, interactive/map, but use a channel only when an asset in it earns a purpose; otherwise skip it with a data-grounded reason recorded in designer.json media_decisions.

channel_fallbacks_before_skipping.video: If no native event/process, animate the strongest still with image2video (parallax/ambient motion) or generate a short scene/chapter-break clip. Almost every story has at least one image worth animating.
channel_fallbacks_before_skipping.audio: BGM is MANDATORY on EVERY blog (no opt-out, no skip for sober/abstract/privacy topics): a REAL background track the Scout sourced, presented as a top-of-article cover-art card (directly below the title) whose cover is a SPINNING VINYL DISC (a circular cover that rotates only while playing; reduced-motion stops the spin) + title + artist + play/pause, that autostarts on the reader's first click/tap — NEVER AI-composed; prefer a license-clean re-hostable track (a copyrighted best-fit track may be self-hosted for the demo behind a publish-gate). When no topic-fitting real track and no signature track exist, the GUARANTEED FLOOR is a license-clean CLASSICAL RECORDING — and a public-domain composition is NOT automatically a public-domain recording, so verify the RECORDING's license (Musopen / Wikimedia PD-CC / IMSLP recordings / FMA CC); prefer period-appropriate else a famous master, mood-appropriate (a somber topic gets a quiet, non-triumphant piece). Embed the official player for a referenced copyrighted recording (anthem, interview, archival); sonify only when a pattern is genuinely decodable by ear and tightly synced to its chart. For a needed sound with no findable real recording, use an opt-in sound_design SFX (text2music) — never the front BGM.
channel_fallbacks_before_skipping.image: Generate atmospheric/metaphorical images even for abstract data (a soft 2-3 when they set a real mood); for visual subjects (places, people, sport, food, nature) aim for a richer set (soft target ~4-6) and prefer real fetched photos. Targets, not quotas: a weakly-visual computational topic (economics/elections/health-stats) whose honest vocabulary is charts/maps must NOT be padded with decorative stock photos to hit a count — the Critic penalizes decorative stock.
channel_fallbacks_before_skipping.interactive_or_map: If no geography, use a guess-reveal, scrubber, before/after, sortable table or mini-demo on a key finding.

presenting_each_channel.image: Full-bleed for impact or framed in-column; consistent treatment (duotone/grade to theme); real photos for concrete subjects (NEVER AI-generate a specific real object/place/person — fetch it or skip), generated ONLY for atmosphere/metaphor; always captioned; mark illustration vs real.
presenting_each_channel.video: Muted, loop, playsinline, with a poster; use as hero or chapter break; keep short (<=6s) and purposeful; pair with a caption.
presenting_each_channel.audio: Integrated, reader-controlled; the sourced-BGM top-of-article cover-art card (below the title) with a SPINNING VINYL DISC cover is MANDATORY on every blog — a real Scout-found track (never AI-composed; license-clean classical RECORDING as the guaranteed floor) that autostarts on the reader's first click/tap, labelled as soundtrack/ambience with the mood it sets; sonification only when genuinely decodable and bound to its visual; always works when muted.
presenting_each_channel.chart: Themed tokens, annotated, highlight the key datum with --accent, tooltips with exact values; vary chart types across the page; no 3-in-a-row without a break.
presenting_each_channel.map: Dark/muted tiles, custom markers on the shared data scale, legend, popups; don't fake a map without real coordinates.
presenting_each_channel.instance: Embed real, oEmbed-verified Spotify/YouTube/audio that lets the reader experience a data point; framed and captioned; copy IDs verbatim from the detective's verified instances.

license_posture.default: License-clean by default: source imagery/footage/audio from Unsplash, Pexels, Pixabay, or Wikimedia Commons (CC / public-domain), respecting each asset's attribution terms (no-attribution and with-attribution sources both fine — record the attribution where required). AI-generated atmosphere/metaphor assets are inherently clean. Prefer this for anything destined for public hosting.
license_posture.accept_ip_for_quality: Using copyrighted media (real broadcast/match footage, an official anthem, press/agency photos) is an EXPLICIT, recorded author choice made only when a clean asset cannot carry the needed quality or specificity — NOT a default.
license_posture.publish_gate: A LOCAL build may use copyrighted ('accept-IP') media to nail the experience, but every such asset MUST be resolved before public hosting: license it, SWAP it for a license-clean equivalent, or consciously accept-with-awareness. Record each accept-IP asset in designer.json media_decisions with its resolution plan; nothing copyrighted ships unresolved.
license_posture.real_subject_photos: Photos of real people/places/objects are EDITORIAL use: VERIFY the identity (right person/place/thing, via the Scout / a credible source) and caption with the subject + credit. Never AI-generate a specific real subject — fetch a verified photo or skip it.
license_posture.entity_photo_rule: Every entity in a card deck (card_deck / entity_cards) MUST have a real, identity-verified photo. A deck mixing real photos with silhouettes/placeholders looks unfinished — get a photo for each entity or cut the entity (or the deck).

variety_rules: Vary which channel is the centerpiece from story to story.
Don't reuse the same teaser structure, audio-card pattern or chart rhythm every time.
Let the dataset choose the mix; richness should feel earned, never quota-filled or decorative.

richness_targets.visual_subject_datasets: around 4-6 images (prefer real photos) + a video (or animated still) + an interactive/map + audio — a soft target, not a quota.
richness_targets.geographic_datasets: an interactive map is the centerpiece; add real place photos and a video/animated still when they earn a purpose.
richness_targets.abstract_or_statistical: lead with precise charts/maps/tables and at least one interactive (guess-reveal/sortable); STILL source a relevant real-image set (historical/archival/atmospheric photos of the era/subject) to back the MANDATORY cinematic scroll background — these relevant real photos are not decorative; skip only generated assets that would feel forced. A fitting real sourced background track (BGM) is MANDATORY too — match a restrained pensive/ambient/minimal mood word to the sober tone (NOT silence); audio.used=false is legitimate ONLY for a privacy_sensitive topic or a genuinely-failed BGM ladder. Video via animated still only if it adds something.
richness_targets.computational_emotionally_flat: (economics, elections, public-health stats, finance — a lead finding that is a number with no dominant mood) the honest data vocabulary is charts/maps/tables/interactives. Do NOT scrape decorative stock photos and do NOT force a tonally-wrong soundtrack to hit a media count — the Critic penalizes decorative stock AND a tonally-wrong track (visual_design→3). But the cinematic scroll background and a fitting front-of-blog BGM are MANDATORY (not opt-in): back the cinematic with relevant real historical/archival photos (or a data_driven chart-spine if none honestly belong), and open with a restrained pensive/ambient real track that fits the sober tone. Each must EARN a purpose (IMMERSE) and be tonally fitting — mandatory means always-present-AND-tasteful, never force-junk.
richness_targets._note: Targets, not quotas: every number here is a soft aim. If a channel would be fabricated, purely decorative, or tonally wrong, skip it with a recorded reason — never pad to a count.
